Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000812": On 2025-11-04 the Ember team saw that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it because it is not their service.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000791": On 2025-10-15 the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000780" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000776": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000767": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000764" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API gates the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000722" [decision]: The job scheduler was owned by the Dune team from 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000703": The authentication gateway is owned by Cinder as of 2025-09-16, having moved from the Ember team.  (about: Cinder, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000666": As of 2025-09-02, most requests to the feature-flags service at peak were identical.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-02, the feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000661" [decision]: On 2025-09-02 the Atlas team decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000600": The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman (Tomasz left the Atlas team on 2025-07-30 to join the Dune team).  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000548": The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000514": The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000453" [decision]: On 2025-06-06 the Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000368": As of 2025-04-29, the job scheduler still relies on the feature-flags service.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000364": As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000242": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000183": The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000043": The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
Existing entity names: billing API, Ember team, Atlas team, image resizer, Cinder, ledger service, feature-flags, Dune team, job scheduler, authentication gateway, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Boreal team, notifier, webhook dispatcher

The note:

[2025-11-06] handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags: Quick one: feature-flags belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to team Atlas for running it until now.
